name: The Deep Dark Expedition
description: A joint Ring, Unbounded, and Array expedition into the deep Nightside to document the Underlumen and find proof that biological symbiosis cannot be synthesized.

meet_sable_passage.label: Meet Sable at the Nightside Passage
meet_sable_passage.description: Sable is waiting at the Nightside Passage beyond the Nightside Depths. She will guide the expedition into the deep dark.

collect_symbiotic_compound.label: Collect a Symbiotic Compound
collect_symbiotic_compound.description: Search the Nightside Passage for symbiotic compounds — crystalline-organic formations that prove biology requires communion, not just chemistry.

reach_underlumen_threshold.label: Reach the Underlumen Threshold
reach_underlumen_threshold.description: Descend through the Nightside Passage to the Underlumen Threshold — the edge of the planet's living core.

return_compound_to_asha.label: Bring the Symbiotic Compound to Asha
return_compound_to_asha.description: Return the symbiotic compound to Councillor Asha Denn at the Civic Center. This evidence could change the balance of power between all three factions.

choose_path.label: Choose Your Path
choose_path.description: The evidence is in. The factions are aligned. Three paths lie ahead: shut down the Array, broker a symbiosis, or seize control. The choice is yours.
